en: Color-tinted postcard view of a riverside promenade lined with large trees and benches, with people walking along the quay. Across the river stand multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the background rises a wooded hill topped by fortification walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill is a prominent tower with a large clock face. The printed caption in red at the top left reads "Murquai mit Schlossberg."
